scripts.build: node ./scripts/build-artifacts.mjs prepare && tsc -b && vite build && node ./scripts/build-artifacts.mjs finalize && node ./scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.build:native: cross-env SOLAR_ATLAS_BUILD_TARGET=native SOLAR_ATLAS_BUILD_ENV=native npm run build && node ./scripts/verify-native-build.mjs
scripts.build:candidate: cross-env SOLAR_ATLAS_INCLUDE_DATASET=1 SOLAR_ATLAS_ALLOW_UNPINNED_DATASET=1 SOLAR_ATLAS_BUILD_ENV=dataset-candidate npm run build
scripts.test:scientific: vitest run tests/unit/event-benchmarks.test.ts tests/unit/lambert.test.ts tests/unit/ephemeris.test.ts tests/unit/satellite-orbit-evidence.test.ts tests/unit/spk.test.ts tests/unit/spk-reference.test.ts tests/unit/kernel-integration.test.ts tests/unit/kernel-window.test.ts tests/unit/missing-body-state.test.ts tests/unit/time-scales-apparent.test.ts tests/unit/osculating.test.ts tests/unit/observation.test.ts tests/unit/crop-spk.test.ts tests/unit/generate-ephemeris-bodies.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.cache/scientific-tests.json && node ./scripts/summarize-scientific-validation.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:scientific && npm run build
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build:native && cap sync && node ./scripts/fix-capacitor-ios-package.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync:android: npm run build:native && cap sync android
scripts.mobile:sync:ios: npm run build:native && cap sync ios && node ./scripts/fix-capacitor-ios-package.mjs
